Game Overview

At its heart, Hospital Doctor is a surgery game about step into the shoes of a busy hospital doctor, treating diverse patients while navigating real-world medical scenarios in a kid-friendly setting. Manage time effectively, master medical tools, and enjoy captivating visuals as you unlock levels with increasingly challenging cases, perfect for aspiring young medical enthusiasts.
